Binned by deviation from local background in the flatfielded panel, red coverage rises through moderate texture (|dev| 20-40 -> 69% red, 40-60 -> 76% red) and then FALLS on the strongest features (|dev| 60-90 -> 46%, |dev| > 90 -> 31%).
